responsibility: Implements generic creation, reuse, resizing, mutation, and deletion of GIMPLE PHI nodes. It manages PHI free lists and allocation statistics, builds PHIs with capacity heuristics, adds/removes arguments as CFG edges change, links PHIs into blocks, detects degenerate PHIs, and handles SSA-use bookkeeping for PHI arguments, providing the core mutable PHI-node infrastructure used by SSA construction and CFG transformations.
same_name_distinction: Implements mutable PHI-node storage and operations: allocation/reuse, resizing, insertion into blocks, argument addition/removal, deletion, and degenerate-PHI handling. Unlike the header, this file owns the PHI management machinery and free-list logic rather than just declaring the API.
